results.title: The Home
results.overview: While on a school trip to a memory care facility a boy, Max, is paired with an elderly woman, Alice, who runs away. Max must navigate his way through all the absurd patients and bizarre things happening in this home with an end goal of finding the woman who just wants to get her real home.

results.title: Kalyanamaram
results.overview: In a quiet hill village, young Mallika shares a deep bond with a tree she calls her friend. When her family plans to cut it down for her sisters wedding, she fights tirelessly to save it ultimately inspiring change and being honoured for her courage.

results.title: Popeye 4 : Resurrection
results.overview: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye, convinced they can bend his legendary strength to their will. Instead, he rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. As chaos spreads and the cult’s plan collapses, one determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all in this explosive finale.

results.title: How to Save the Immortal 2: Elixir of Life
results.overview: Drybone the Immortal and shieldmaiden Barbara are preparing for their wedding, but not all of Barbara's relatives are happy about the union. Her strong-willed aunt, Queen Brungilda, believes her niece deserves a more suitable match. In a misguided attempt to stop the wedding, she unwittingly casts a powerful sleeping charm on Barbara. The Queen proclaims that the legendary Elixir of Life can save Barbara, but only a true noble knight will survive the treacherous path to the Elixir, hidden in a perilous place where danger lurks at every turn. Drybone, known as a dark sorcerer, stands no chance in this noble quest, so he enlists Elijah, a true and valiant knight but clumsy and fearful , to join him. In a tale filled with action, magic, and humor, only a true  hero can save Barbara and restore peace and joy to the kingdom.  Elixir of Life is an epic animated family adventure that celebrates love, bravery, and the quest for genuine heroism.

results.title: Queens for a Day
results.overview: A controversial talk show host wakes up and finds herself back in the 1950s forced to live not her own life, but that of her mother’s. What might be an amusing trip down Memory Lane, turns into a dark and horrifying nightmare. And to make matters worse, she ends up having to raise herself as a child.

results.title: Vintage Violence
results.overview: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

results.title: Musk's Dream of Mars: The Price on Earth
results.overview: With dreams of colonising Mars and beyond, billionaires such as Elon Musk or Jeff Bezos are fuelling a boom in the space industry. But many criticise the pollution and resources needed for such an endeavour. By promising humanity’s survival through an escape into space, New Space may be contributing to the destruction of our planet.

results.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
results.original_title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
results.overview: Nelly and Detective Michael set out to solve the  murder of a guest while at a lavish dinner.

results.title: Correveidiles Teatro: Halloween is here
results.overview: Music video for the song "Halloween is here" by Correveidiles Teatro

results.title: The Interview
results.overview: Four strangers on their way to a job interview get stuck in a lift. They share their trauma, only to discover that the interview has already begun.

results.title: Jayanti 2
results.overview: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

results.title: Deep Cuts
results.overview: This feature-length documentary is one of the main features on the House of Hammer Volume 1 blu ray set. It explains the censorship system in the United States and why so many movies were subject to it. It also covers aspects of the UK's BBFC in the 50s and 60s.

results.title: Aadu 3 Part 1
results.overview: Shaji Pappan and Co. opens a Pandora's box of reincarnations and multiple timelines  leading to comic chaos of epic proportions.

results.title: Amadeo and the Hypothetical New World
results.original_title: Amadeo e o Hipotético Mundo Novo
results.overview: Amadeo, a young African inventor who creates the photographic camera before Europeans. Set in Brazil in 1830, he uses his invention to help liberate enslaved people while facing an impossible love story with the daughter of a powerful baron.

results.title: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
results.overview: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.

results.title: Capicú
results.overview: When a young college student loses her financial aid, an ecstatic classmate presents her an unusual solution to keep her college career alive.

results.title: Reviving Robin
results.overview: Documentary directed and edited by Peter Flynn capturing the entire process of archiving and releasing Robin. Featuring interviews with stars, preservationists, along with newly uncovered outtakes, behind-the-scenes ephemera, and never-before-seen promotional materials

results.title: The Good Daughter
results.overview: After her parents’ separation, Carmela and her mother move into her grandmother’s home. As Carmela struggles to adjust to her new reality, she longs to spend more time at her father’s place, a visual artist she both admires and idolizes. His presence looms over the three generations of women, pushing them to confront and decide the future they each deserve.

results.title: Matter of Time
results.overview: Charlie Fleck, a 29-year-old aspiring video game designer, is has the opportunity of a lifetime with a time-stopping device given to him by his friend, an eccentric Toy shop owner Gibbs. Challenges ensues, and hardships arise as he navigates world, and pursue his dreams
